COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Object Oriented Programming Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Concepts.

2. When learning Logic Gates, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Gates.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Gates.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Gates.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Logic Gates.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Logic Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Circuits.

5. When learning Relational Database Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Relational Database Fundamentals.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Relational Database Fundamentals.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

7. When learning Web Development Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Web Development Fundamentals.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Web Development Fundamentals.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Web Development Fundamentals.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Web Development Fundamentals.

8. When learning Object Oriented Programming Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

10. When learning Data Representation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Representation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Representation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data Representation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Representation.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. When learning Network Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Security.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Security.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Network Security.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Web Development Fundamentals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Data Representation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Binary Arithmetic Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Logic Gates and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. C — Information and Communication Technology
